title: Settings pages on a wide screen
question: A ministry's Settings (and your Account page) is a narrow column with the right side empty. Which way for every settings page in the admin panel?

options.label: A: Cards all the way across
options.thesis: The cards fill the pane to its right edge; short fields pair up two to a line so a field never runs a metre long.
options.viewport: Kids Ministries' Settings: The details card spans the pane, Name beside In a line, About full width, then the switches card.
options.risk: Long lines of text and switches far from their labels on a very wide window.

options.label: B: The column centred
options.thesis: The cards keep their 820px reading width and sit in the middle of the pane, with equal space either side.
options.viewport: Kids Ministries' Settings: the same cards as today, centred under the tabs.
options.risk: The tabs start at the left while the cards start further in.
